bio:
My name is Paulina Alford and I am a Ruby on Rails developer since 2016. I started my career in Software Houses where I’ve been building Web Applications - usually from scratch, but sometimes joining in to what others have started. Although my career is mostly connected with Ruby on Rails, I am also a JavaScript Fullstack developer.

I was part of the team that implemented first Decidim platforms in Poland: Konsultujemy for Gdańsk and two projects for Warsaw: Konsultacje społeczne and Budżet Obywatelski - I still have many great memories from working on those projects and will always be grateful for being part of this journey.

My path lead me further though, to big companies with their own products, where every day was a new challenge on so many levels. I love the architectural work and planning features, but most of all I care about the people I work with. As we spend so much time with our coworkers I believe that they are the most important part of any workplace - codebase can always be fixed, processes can be adjusted, but people need to be appreciated.

In my free time - hue hue - I like reading books and writing my own stories. When outdoors I mostly stroll - I’m definitely not a sporty type.
